votes.motion: A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Zach Robinson to adopt Resolution 23-19C, a resolution increasing total appropriations within the governmental funds for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2022 and ending June 30, 2023
A motion was made by Brooke D'Sousa, seconded by Marci Houseman to continue the Public Hearing until the next City Council Business session on June 20, 2023
A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Marci Houseman to recess the City Council and convene a meeting of the Redevelopment Board

A motion was made by Ryan Mecham, seconded by Scott Earl to adopt Resolution 23-21C authorizing execution of an interlocal cooperation agreement to participate in a local consortium of the Federal Home Program and authorizing the City to enter into agreements for the use of the Home funds

A motion was made by Marci Houseman, seconded by Brooke D'Sousa to adopt Resolution 23-22C, as amended per the meeting discussion, a resolution adopting a Sandy City Council policy outlining and requiring periodic administrative management studies
